title: Special floor area provisions for zoning lots containing comfort stations
previewText: For zoning lots containing a comfort station provided in accordance with the provisions of paragraph (c)(2) of Section 139-51 (Area-wide Modifications), an area equal to 200 percent of the floor space within such comfort station may be exempted from the definition of floor area.
